name: sf90-live-2026-08-18
note: Live run 5b16061b (2026-08-18, the first on the ceiling model): 17 typed comps and 9 typed prices as the workers reported them. The comps worker filed the autoastat salvage sales under the rebuilt lane; the price worker returned an SF90XX hood, a front frame section under the panels line, a Novitec aftermarket piece, and a LaFerrari comparison pack. Recorded verbatim; the pipeline must screen them.

areas.description: Front bumper cover, both headlights, and splitter are torn off/missing entirely on both corners; underlying crash-can/bumper beam visible but no obvious rail bending in photos.

Right front fender and bumper gone, wheel sits at a slightly toed-out angle with brake caliper and knuckle exposed - consistent with a hard corner impact possibly bending suspension links or the knuckle itself.
Left mirror torn loose and hanging by wiring, left fender edge damaged, but less severe than right side.
Rear bumper fascia and diffuser fully removed, exposing exhaust, cooling lines, and orange high-voltage hybrid cabling/connectors - these need isolation testing before any handling.
Possible small crack or chip visible in windshield reflection near dash cluster; otherwise glass appears intact in other shots.
Seats, dash, wheel and airbag covers appear undamaged and un-deployed; odometer reads only 3004 miles.

With both bumper covers off, front and rear crash structures and cooling/hybrid plumbing are visible but no fluid leaks or torn subframe members are evident in these angles - hidden damage still possible beneath tub.

observations.note: Front right corner completely torn away - bumper, fender, headlight all missing; front right wheel/suspension knuckle exposed with brake caliper visible and wheel pushed at odd angle, suggesting suspension damage.
Left side profile shows front bumper/fender destroyed on left front corner too, mirror hanging by wire; rear bumper cover also removed exposing hybrid wiring and structure.
Rear three-quarter view shows rear bumper fascia completely removed, exposing exhaust, diffuser structure, and orange high-voltage cabling; right side skirt scraped.
Front view confirms both front corners deformed/missing bumper and headlights, front splitter hanging, radiator support area exposed but no visible frame rail crush.
Overhead front shot shows hood and cowl intact but bumper beam and headlight brackets torn away at both corners, indicating a broad frontal impact.
Rear straight-on view: bumper cover gone, taillights loose, diffuser panel hanging, exhaust tips visible, hybrid module and orange HV cable exposed - electrical exposure risk.
Interior driver/passenger seats look clean and undamaged, airbag covers on wheel and dash intact and not deployed.
Interior wide shot shows dash, wheel, and seats undamaged, steering airbag cover intact.
Dash cluster powered on showing only 3004 miles, multiple warning icons lit (likely due to disconnected sensors/bumpers), windshield has crack/chip visible in reflection area.
Rear engine cover/glass area looks intact, Ferrari badge and taillight trim present, bumper substructure below shows same missing cover as other rear photos.
Hood/cowl close-up shows only minor smudges, no structural deformation, panel gaps look factory.
VIN and Ferrari data plate tag, confirms 2021 SF90 Stradale, no damage information.

triage.drivetrainRisk: No engine or transaxle components appear disturbed in these shots; the mid-engine bay isn't shown, but the front (motor/inverter area) and rear (ICE/hybrid) bumper removal expose HV cabling that must be isolation-checked before any drivetrain work - risk is more electrical/hybrid-system than mechanical drivetrain damage.
